strings.app.title: PDF Compressor
strings.app.subtitle: Compress · Merge · Split · Images to PDF · Auto-fit to a target size
strings.files.title: Files
strings.files.empty_dnd:
No files yet
Drag PDFs or images into the window, or click "+ Add files"
strings.files.empty:
No files yet
Click "+ Add files" to choose PDFs or images
strings.progress.title: Progress
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.omode.label: Output mode
strings.omode.hint.each: Each file becomes its own PDF. For PDFs, type a page range in the list to keep only those pages.
strings.omode.hint.merge: All files (PDFs and images) are joined into one PDF in list order. Use ↑ ↓ to reorder.
strings.omode.hint.split: Each PDF is cut into several files by page count (images are unaffected and output separately).
strings.merge.name: Merged file name
strings.cmode.label: Compression mode
strings.target.label: Target size (MB, per output file)
strings.dpi.label: DPI (starting value in auto mode)
strings.quality.label: JPEG quality (manual mode only)
strings.msg.no_files: Please add PDFs or images first!
strings.msg.bad_target: Target size must be a number greater than 0
strings.msg.lang_busy: Can't change the language while processing
strings.log.limit_note: (still over target; this is the limit)
strings.run.warn_bigger: ⚠ Output is not smaller (the original may already be small). Keep the original.
strings.err.pdf_open: Cannot open {name} (it may be password-protected or damaged)
strings.err.pdf_page_out: Page number out of range in {name} ({n} pages)
strings.err.range_reversed: Page range "{part}": the start page is after the end page
strings.err.range_out: Page range "{part}" is out of bounds (this file has {n} pages)
strings.err.no_pagecount_range: Can't read the page count, so the page range can't be applied
strings.err.no_pagecount_split: Can't read the page count (password-protected?), so it can't be split
strings.cli.no_ctk: customtkinter is missing. Run: pip install -r requirements.txt
strings.dnd.unavailable: Drag and drop is unavailable ({err}). Make sure tkinterdnd2 is installed (pip install tkinterdnd2).
strings.dnd.admin: Running as administrator: Windows blocks dragging files in from Explorer. Restart the app without admin rights (or use "+ Add files").
